messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She dances in place, moving her arms, hips, and head, then turns and faces the camera while standing still.","camera":"A vertical, eye-level shot that starts as a full-body view and slowly zooms in to a medium close-up of her upper body.","clothing":"A red bikini top and bottom with a dark pattern, an open red robe with a yellow star pattern, and red sneakers.","hair_color":"Red.","hairstyle":"Red hair styled in a high ponytail with straight bangs across the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young woman with a slim build, fair skin, and a small belly button piercing.","scene":"A dimly lit, narrow alleyway at night decorated with red lanterns and triangular bunting, with brick walls and neon signs in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a bright stone courtyard with a large rock structure to a dim night alley with red lanterns, bunting, brick walls, and neon signs. The character, red ponytail, red star-patterned outfit, dance motion, and gradual zoom-in remain largely consistent, and the character is lit with warm reddish light from the new scene.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original daytime outdoor scene with the reference night alley environment while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, with natural lighting on the person.
uncertain: Whether the camera framing and movement are exactly identical to the source, since the new background makes precise comparison difficult.
unexpected_changes: The character's overall lighting and color cast changed from bright daylight to warm red/orange night lighting, as expected from the new scene but still a visible change in appearance.
